title: Markets Turn Volatile as Iran Tensions Threaten Global Energy Supply
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Global markets have turned volatile as renewed US-Iran tensions and fears over the Strait of Hormuz push oil prices higher and revive inflation concerns.

title: Asian Markets Rally as United States and Iran Move Closer to Possible Deal
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: Asian stock markets climbed as optimism grew over a possible US-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, easing fears about oil prices and global inflation.

title: Nvidia Reports Record $81.6 Billion Quarter as AI Boom Accelerates
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue of $81.6 billion as booming global demand for AI infrastructure and Blackwell AI chips continued driving explosive growth.

title: Global Markets Slide as United States-Iran Tensions Push Oil Prices Higher
author: Markets Desk
excerpt: Global financial markets reacted sharply to renewed U.S.-Iran tensions as oil prices climbed, inflation fears grew, and investors monitored instability around the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Gold Hits Record High as Safe Haven Asset
author: Maria Sanchez
excerpt: Investors fleeing geopolitical instability and currency volatility have poured capital into gold, pushing the precious metal past the $3,000 mark for the first time.

title: Global Markets Slide as Oil Surges Above $100 Amid Middle East Tensions
author: Jessica Wu
excerpt: Global markets fall as oil prices surge above $100 amid Middle East tensions, raising concerns about inflation, supply disruptions, and economic stability.

title: U.S. Inflation Surges as Iran War Drives Gas Prices and Energy Costs Higher
author: Alex Thorne
excerpt: U.S. inflation jumped sharply in April as the Iran conflict pushed oil and gas prices higher, increasing pressure on consumers, businesses, and the Federal Reserve.

title: Bond Yields Invert Signaling Recession Risk
author: Sarah Jenkins
excerpt: The spread between the 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields inverted to its deepest level in four decades, flashing a classic warning signal for an impending recession.
